title: OpenPlant workflows and connector status
description: Explore OpenPlant workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Bentley Systems

OpenPlant

OpenPlant supports plant design, piping and equipment information across multidisciplinary projects.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Place tagged equipment

Start from the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended OpenPlant preview, place tagged equipment; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Route plant piping

Begin with the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended OpenPlant preview, route plant piping; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Review an isometric package

Use the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended OpenPlant preview, review an isometric package; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
